glass.official_category: Glass Bottles and Jars & Other Containers

modulation.passive_factors_in_rates: No passive eco-modulation column. Acceptance status (USCL = statewide collection list, PRO = PRO take-back list, N/A = not accepted) is priced into the base fee; non-accepted materials must carry a higher average base fee (ORS 459A.884(3)(a)). 2027 adds two reserve-drawdown columns (SIM only, and Other) that lower base to final: CAA is returning about $80 million in reserves plus $3 million of previously collected SIM fees.

active_bonuses.name: LCA Bonus A (disclosure)
active_bonuses.adjustment: 10% of base fees on the SKU's primary packaging, excluding the reserve share (about 8% net)
active_bonuses.timing: Bonuses for 2027 credited against 2027 base fees

active_bonuses.name: LCA Bonus B (impact reduction)
active_bonuses.adjustment: Multiple of Bonus A by impact-reduction tier: 10-40% x2.0, 40-70% x2.5, 70%+ x3.0 (DEQ-directed values, 2025-09-12)
active_bonuses.cap: Plan caps $40,000 / $45,000 / $50,000 per SKU or batch
active_bonuses.timing: Changes from December 2024 onward; submissions were due 2026-05-31; credited on 2027 base fees

active_bonuses.name: LCA Bonus C (switch to reuse or refill)
active_bonuses.cap: $40,000 (projected return rates) or $50,000 (actual return or refill rates) per SKU or batch
active_bonuses.timing: Switch on or after 2024-12-01; submissions were due 2026-05-31; credited on 2027 base fees

state_targets: ORS 459A.926: statewide recycling rate for plastic packaging and plastic food serviceware of at least 25% by 2028, 50% by 2040, 70% by 2050

notes: PRIMARY DOCUMENT VIA MIRROR: the CAA '2027 Oregon Producer Fees Schedule' (published 2026-10-01) was read from a third-party copy at eprfeecheck.com because the official circularactionalliance.org link redirects to a host that could not be opened. Every row that SPI (secondary, 2026-10-26) also prints matches exactly. rate_usd_per_lb is the Final Fee Rate (what is invoiced) = base + Reserve Drawdown (SIM Only) + Reserve Drawdown (Other); base_rate_usd_per_lb is the Base Fee Rate. 2027 rates are printed to the whole cent, so small rows carry up to +/-0.5 cent rounding. glass 0.00 is a real published rate (not missing). aluminum -0.09 is a negative rate (a credit); code must allow negatives. molded-pulp maps to 'Other Paper Packaging' because the only molded row, 'Other Paper Packaging - Molded Pulp Food Serviceware' ($0.43 final, N/A), is limited to food serviceware; shipping inserts are not food serviceware (best-supported choice, not confirmed by a CAA definition). eps-foam maps to 'PS (#6) White Expanded/Foamed Cushioning' (PRO); colored foam peanuts or inserts fall under 'PS (#6) Colored Expanded/Foamed Cushioning' at $0.74 final ($1.13 base). Tertiary/transport non-consumer corrugated is $0.00 but does not apply to boxes shipped to consumers. Invoiced 50% in January and 50% in July 2027. Optional flat fee for producers supplying 10 metric tons or less: $700 (1-2.5 t), $1,300 (2.5-5 t), $2,200 (5-7.5 t), $3,100 (7.5-10 t).
